_guide: // profile.json - the one person this site belongs to. `profile` is an OBJECT, not an array.
// schemaVersion: always 1. It tells the loader which shape to expect; do not change it.
// REQUIRED: profile.name. Everything else is optional; an empty value is hidden, never rendered blank.
// name: full display name, used as the page <h1> and in the document title.
// alternateName: a second attested name, shown as 'Also known as ...'. Remove if not wanted.
// professionalTitle: role line, e.g. 'React Web Developer'.
// tagline: short uppercase kicker above the name.
// shortIntroduction: one or two sentences; also becomes the meta description.
// biography: the About paragraph. Empty removes the About block.
// profileImage: path to a photo (e.g. ./assets/images/profile.webp). Empty draws initials instead.
// location: region-level only, e.g. 'Bihar, India'. Do not put a street address here.
// email: plain address; rendered as a mailto link and in the footer.
// availability: { enabled, label }. enabled false hides the status pill.
// resume: { enabled, file, label }. Point file at a real PDF before enabling.
// primaryActions: buttons that jump to a section; target must be a section id.
// socialLinks: { id, platform, url, icon, enabled }. Only http(s) URLs are rendered.
// highlights: extra { label, value } rows in the at-a-glance card.
// This file contains no dates and no phone number on purpose.

profile.name: Er shreenidhi
profile.shortIntroduction: I build responsive, accessible web interfaces with React and JavaScript, and back them with .NET Core, Python and SQL Server.
profile.biography: I am a React web developer from Bihar, India. I work on the front end with React, JavaScript and CSS, and on the server side with .NET Core, Python and SQL Server. I also take on freelance work part time.
